purpose: Arrival and departure luggage walking strips

prompts.balanced: Use case: identity-preserve. Premium painterly raster 2D game sprite strip, transparent RGBA. Reference image locks young tan male face, dark swept hair, mustard cardigan, ivory shirt, navy trousers, brown boots and satchel. Create four DISTINCT full-body side-view walking poses facing RIGHT, pulling small burgundy suitcase behind LEFT via telescopic handle. Four gait phases: left contact, passing, right contact, opposite passing. Same luggage, costume, scale, camera, baseline and head height in all frames. Landscape 2:1 canvas with FOUR separate silhouettes evenly spaced horizontally. Each entire person AND suitcase fits within 75% of one equal-width quarter of canvas. CRITICAL leave large fully transparent gutters between silhouettes: no shoe may touch next frame's suitcase. Reduce character height enough to guarantee spacing. Complete hair, hands, shoes, wheels; shoe soles and wheels at shared baseline. Preserve reference warm polished hand-painted game style, cloth texture and readable silhouette. No text, grid, scenery, ground, cast shadows, vector art, halos or isolated speckles.
